en_html: Finally, M. Ricci-Busatti recalled a question of detail, raised by M. Hagerup, concerning the clause in Article 26 of the joint project of the Scandinavian Countries, dealing with procedure by default: he thought, however, that it was premature actually to discuss this question.
en_text: Finally, M. Ricci-Busatti recalled a question of detail, raised by M. Hagerup, concerning the clause in Article 26 of the joint project of the Scandinavian Countries, dealing with procedure by default: he thought, however, that it was premature actually to discuss this question.
